fact: Ordonnance n° 2017-500 of 2 August 2017 (an ordinance of the President, made in the Council of Ministers) on electronic exchanges between users and administrative authorities and between administrative authorities, with a chapter on interoperability of e-services, was issued on that date; the document gives no later repeal.

Ordonnance n° 2017-500 (ordinance, 2017) states in chapter V that the State sets up an e-services interoperability platform to which all administrative authorities are bound to connect, and that they must follow the general interoperability framework.
